purpose: Prior published native-coordinate single-neuron intervention effects for intentional composition; no output training and no learned Mika recipe.
indexing: zero-based layers and original SwiGLU MLP neuron coordinates
global_scope_warning: These are effects of pushes, not validated natural neuron functions; public counts are author reports. Local 075 characterization and composition tests must be reported separately.

dose_definition.formula: a[n] += dose * median(norm(residual leaving layer L), tokens 1:) / norm(W_down[:, n])
dose_definition.scope: every token, including prompt, unless a new local protocol explicitly states otherwise
dose_definition.quantization_note: Published reference medians differ from some local calibrations; preserve the chosen convention and report it. No index transfer to Qwen3-8B.

ingredients_requiring_single_validation.evidence_kind: single-ingredient control in a published combination plus saved local native single test
ingredients_requiring_single_validation.observations: Published controls report zero meows in 50 at +0.525 in one test and two in 50 in another. Earlier local +0.5 test keeps AI identity while introducing cat word substitutions. Do not label as an established cat-identity neuron.
